Gemini Notebook (formerly NotebookLM)
Unlike general chatbots that query the open web, Gemini Notebook functions as an expert on the specific documents you provide. It reads, synthesizes, and cites directly from sources like your lecture notes, PDFs, research papers, and Google Drive files. Gemini Notebook responses are grounded primarily in the sources you provide and include citations back to those sources.
